notes.title: Astral Savior – Version 1.0.104 Update
notes.notes:
Astral Savior – Version 1.0.104 Update[hr][/hr]
🔧 Fixes & Improvements:

Fixed an issue where Power Up were not applied properly

Fixed certain UI texts not displaying correctly

Fixed character demo videos not playing

Improved the upgrade interface during battle
[hr][/hr]
📌 About the Power Up save issue:
We discovered that starting a New Game could sometimes cause save data issues, leading to Power Ups not being saved or reset.

This bug has been fixed in this update.
If you were affected, all previously spent upgrade gold has been refunded based on your save record.

Please update the game and relaunch to confirm.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience,
and thank you for your continued support of Astral Savior!
